posts.linkedin:
Late-night messages often sit unanswered, causing missed opportunities for small businesses.

A customer may send a message at 11 pm and not receive a reply until the next morning. Many shop owners in India spend their evenings typing the same answers on WhatsApp or Instagram. A café owner repeats opening‑hour information, a gym owner repeats membership rates, and a clinic owner repeats location details. When messages arrive at night, they are often seen only the following day, and some customers leave without ever getting a response.

I create a simple AI chatbot that can answer common customer questions and collect enquiries automatically. The bot is not a live agent and does not replace your own judgement. The basic version can reply to the most common questions you provide and forward WhatsApp leads. A more advanced version can be trained on your product catalogue and can help collect leads automatically.

First, you tell me what you sell and the questions you receive most often. I then build the chatbot using those answers as its sole knowledge base. You review the replies and request changes until the tone matches yours. You pay only after you approve the final setup.

The bot can reduce repetitive messaging by answering common queries at any hour, including nights and holidays. All enquiries are stored in a single place, helping keep them organized and reducing the chance of them being missed between WhatsApp, your website, or other direct messages. This saves you time searching old chats and lets you focus on the work that matters.

The solution works best for owners who receive the same questions every day and want a single inbox for enquiries. It does not handle complex issues that require a human response, and it cannot guarantee increased sales or any specific result.

If you think this could help your business, I am happy to discuss the details. Payment is required only after you approve the work. DM BOT
posts.bluesky: A customer asks about your timings or prices at 11 pm. A custom chatbot replies using only the answers you gave it, and hands the chat to you if it does not know. Pay after approval. DM BOT to discuss fit. 💬
